name: 01_sheet_transfer
title: Slide-sheet transfer
subtitle: Two G1s move a patient from the gurney to the OR table on a slide sheet with handle bars. B pulls across the table, A feeds from the gurney side.

captions.text: The patient lies on a slide sheet on the gurney. The gurney is pushed against the OR table at the same height.
B leans across the table for the far handle bar. A takes the near bar on the gurney side.
Stroke 1: B pulls down and back over the table edge while A pushes. Patient and sheet slide as one piece.
A's reach ends at the gurney edge, so it lets go. B steps back and keeps pulling.
The patient is centered on the OR table. B lets go.
